subject: Tiny snag with this morning's handoff
text:
Hi there,

I wanted to flag a tiny snag before the next meeting. The client asked us to include a short summary slide, but the template they sent this morning has the old title and slightly off margins. I can still build it, though I may need a few extra minutes to clean it up.

There is also a small scheduling wrinkle: the reviewer might join the call a little later than planned. If that happens, I suggest we start with the timeline section and move the budget piece toward the end. That way, we don't waste time repeating notes once everyone settles in.

Please don't worry too much about it. It is the kind of last-minute complication that feels annoying for about two minutes and then disappears. I will keep the original formatting in the notes just in case the client asks for a copy later. It may sound overly cautious, but I would rather leave a clear trail than try to reconstruct it under pressure. If you already have comments, even rough ones, I can use them now rather than waiting until we are in front of the screen.

I have a backup draft ready, so we are not stuck. If you notice anything else in the file, send it over and I will fold it in.

Thanks for rolling with these little shifts. I appreciate how smoothly the team handles them.

Cheers,
